prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: single high fidelity desktop web application screenshot
Generate ONE landscape image, desktop web app UI mockup at 1440x1000. Render actual application surface edge-to-edge, no device frame, no 3D, no illustrations, no hero, no gradients.
Russian-language operational dispatch queue for event applications. Minimal warmwhite #faf9f5 background, graphite #252923 type, forest #426849 primary action. Single modern system sans-serif, exceptionally polished usable product workspace. Precise typographic hierarchy, calm spacing, thin subtle dividers, restrained rounded corners. No sidebar.
Top horizontal navigation: product name "Заявки на мероприятия" left, subtle "Локальный прототип" label nearby, role switch "Организатор" / "Согласующий" on right.
Below main heading "Все заявки", primary forest green button "Новая заявка" on right.
Status navigation "Все", "На согласовании", "На доработке", "Подготовка", "Готово", with "Все" selected understated.
Search input "Найти мероприятие". Label sample rows explicitly "Демонстрационные данные".
Large task-first registry, wide elegant rows with equal attention to row information, decisive event title and one next step per row. Design these three complete rows:
"Семинар отдела" — status "На доработке" — "Уточните программу и число участников" — action "Исправить заявку".
"Встреча клуба" — status "На согласовании" — "Ожидает решения".
"Конференция команды" — status "Согласовано" — "Осталось 2 из 4 задач" — action "Продолжить подготовку".
No fake dates, people, avatars, counts, metrics or invented extra row data. Status chips subtle neutral tones, return state warm muted ochre, approved soft forest. Main row content fills generous center width and maintains abundant whitespace underneath. Russian text verbatim and legible, usable minimal app screenshot with no marketing decorations.
